task.title: Explore an interface for storing specs/plans as well as tasks
task.description:
Coding agents are now designed to write spec and plan files as part of their agentic workflows.
Typically, these get saved as markdown files and committed to the repository, or else they're treated as transitory artifacts that get deleted once the feature is done. Neither of these is optimal:
 - Permanent artifacts that ride with the codebase help to capture decisions that were made about implementation that may not be captured in the code itself.
 - Markdown files themselves are not very expressive, they tend to lack metadata that is relevant, such as linking to related tasks or other specs, plus image attachments, comments, etc.
 - Spec files committed to the repo suffer from the same global state problem as a TODO.md file: they can easily get out of sync across branches. A spec can often relate to many individual tasks, which may be worked on in parallel by agents, who in turn may update the spec as the work is completed, without a good way to keep that information in sync.

Workbook provides a solution to a very similar problem for tasks, so it's a natural extension to allow it to also handle specs/plans. This would be a new page or interface separate from tasks, but would use most of the same mechanisms and vocabulary, and allow direct and deep linking of specs to their related tasks.
